title: либо, или … или, то … то, не то … не то

items: Пое́ду]] [[на]] [[Кавка́з]] '''ли́бо''' [[в]] [[Крым]].|I'll go to the Caucasus, '''or''' Crimea. / I'll go to the Caucasus, '''either that or''' Crimea.
Come here, '''or else''' I'll go get you!
the wrong thing, the wrong one, something wrong
Говори́]] [[ти́ше]], '''не то''' [[услы́шат]].|Keep your voice down '''before''' they hear us.
